entities.summary: Brackenheim is a town in the Landkreis Heilbronn in Baden-Württemberg in southern Germany. It is 15 kilometres (9 mi) southwest of Heilbronn. With 826 hectares of vineyards, it is the biggest grape-growing municipality of Württemberg.
